title: The Window
scene: The radio finds her. It does not always. She says, are the cats all right. You say, Gracie is. You stop. She says the pass is still closed. You say you know. She does not ask how the driving is going. You do not tell her. The window stays, and then it is gone.
debrief: She asks about the cats. She mentions the pass. She does not ask how the driving is going. You got the window.

source.teaching_target: Mom is a voice. She asks about the cats and the pass. She does not ask how the driving is going. The window stays because Ali got out.
